text:
marie: quick heads-up — after the kernel-selection change in canary, prefix cache hit-rate dropped ~18% for chat short-context workloads. attaching profiler snippet and a couple quick logs. anyone else seeing this?

oz: yup, same in my traces. hit-rate loss concentrated at seq_len <= 64 and models using bpe tokenization. looks like key canonicalization mismatch after tokenization tweak.

sam: do we have concrete examples of differing cache keys? paste from profiler: 
```
model: redwood-chat-small
seq_bucket: 1-64
old_hit_rate: 0.72
new_hit_rate: 0.59
sample_key_before: "user:hi\ncontext:summary"
sample_key_after:  "user:␠hi\ncontext:summary"  # leading-space token inserted by new tokenizer
```

katie: that leading-space token explains a lot. client SDKs currently build cache keys from raw prompt bytes; if tokenization changes server-side we lose hits. we should normalize on server and add a canonicalization pass: trim leading spaces, normalize newlines to "\n", collapse multi-spaces to single.

andre: concrete risk: streaming+retry flow makes this worse. client retries send same prompt but streaming chunks sometimes include/omit prefix whitespace (due to chunk boundaries), creating several keys and thrashing small cache. we should: make prefill probes idempotent, add dedup-id header, and make retry backoff avoid re-warming cache for same request.

marie: proposal:
- short-term: add server-side canonicalization (trim/collapse) + metric to track canonicalization-induced key collisions.
- mid-term: SDK flag `cache_warmup=probing` and header `RW-Cache-Opt: prefill;dedup=<id>` for clients that want explicit warmup.
- add a lightweight probe endpoint: `POST /v1/cache/prefill` that accepts dedup_id and canonicalized prompt (no streaming) so SDKs can call once per session.

sam: SDK idea: cacheWarmup=true by default for mobile/slow-start apps, but opt-out via `cache_warmup=off`. we should also expose `cache_key_version` header so server can reject or translate old keys during rollouts.

oz: another datapoint: kernel selection change also altered small-batch packing behavior (we now pack more aggressively). that changes KV cache lifecycle because some requests that used to land on same host now get routed differently (less local KV hit affinity). combined effect = fewer local hits + less global hit reuse. need to tweak routing/batching heuristics to keep affinity for short-chat flows.

katie: action items from product/devex perspective: update SDK docs + examples (curl + python) for the new headers. sample curl for probe: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/cache/prefill 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" 
  -H "RW-Cache-Opt: prefill;dedup=abc123" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-small","prompt":"user: hi\ncontext: short"}'
```

andre: runtime changes: add dedup table TTL (5m) for prefills, make prefill ops non-evicting for first N tokens to avoid thrash, and record prefills as low-weight metadata in KV so eviction heuristics favor real traffic. also add metric `cache.prefill.duplicate_count`.

marie: temporary mitigation we can ship today: revert the tokenization tweak for the canary group and rerun perf job. if revert isn't possible, we at least need server-side canonicalization and the dedup header.

deploy-bot: canary deploy 2026-03-17T12:03:45Z -> runtime-kernel/v2.14 succeeded (canary: 3 hosts).

sam: note on retries/streaming edge-case: for streaming clients that re-open connections after a transient, SDK should preserve dedup id across reconnects and avoid re-sending prefill for the same session. recommend `X-RW-Dedup: <session-id>` header.

katie: leaving small checklist here:
- [ ] revert canary OR add server canonicalization (marie)
- [ ] SDK flags + docs (katie + sam)
- [ ] probe endpoint + dedup TTL (andre)
- [ ] metrics & dashboard (oz)
- [ ] validate batching-routing affinity in perf job (oz + andre)

andre: i'll open a runtime PR for dedup table + prefill logic, and add a unit test for canonicalization.

marie: thanks all — i'll file the regression ticket with the profiler traces and mark urgent. if you have short repros pls paste them here.

oz: dropping one small repro: minimal curl that produced different key strings because of newline vs CRLF: `echo -e "user: hi\r\ncontext: x" | base64` — server normalized to LF, kernel tokenized CRLF differently. that was the seed.

sam: ack, will add CRLF normalization to SDK and quick patch to server.

katie: i'll update the docs PR and announce the SDK opt-in flag in #devex once we have the probe endpoint merged. :thumbsup:

marie: tagging follow-up owners: @oz @andre @sam @katie.
